_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into your Claude Desktop config: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json on Windows (older installs: %APPDATA%\Claude\...), ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS. Fully quit Claude Desktop (tray icon -> Quit) and relaunch afterwards. Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and Git.
